notes:
Replication report title, SCORE RR ID z189, authors, OSF project agv64, and original reference match the assigned reference. Target identified from the report’s coded claim 4 and regression description. No Cohen's f² is printed for the target interaction; extracted the printed unstandardized coefficient without conversion. Original statistics quoted in the replication report were not treated as independently verified original-paper evidence. Original acquisition: DOI/publisher landing did not yield accessible full text; Unpaywall and OpenAlex report no OA location; Stanford repository alternative returned a 403 challenge. No paid or signed-in acquisition used.
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Supplied source_version_note identifies the published article, pages 759–777; no manuscript or supplement substitution was used. Visually inspected rendered PDF page 8 (printed page 766) and compared its numerical results with canonical text. Input has no original study identifier or neutral outcome description and supplies only p. 8. That page contains multiple distinct tests for two outcomes; requested Cohen's f^2 does not distinguish them and is not printed among the candidate results on that page. Therefore no unique target study/outcome/sample/test can be established and no candidate statistic or general recruited sample was substituted. Canonical text contains math-font extraction substitutions (including ¼ for the rendered equals sign and a control glyph for the rendered multiplication sign); no normalized quotations or derived metrics were supplied. Original source is available; locator insufficiency is the reason for null original statistics. Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
